name: distribute-content
description: Takes source content (article, blog post, or URL) and produces platform-optimized posts for Twitter/X and LinkedIn, with a scheduling plan

agents.name: content-analyzer
agents.prompt: Analyze the provided source content and extract key messages, tone, and quotable lines for social media adaptation

agents.name: twitter-writer
agents.prompt: Write Twitter/X posts (single tweet or thread) using the content analysis from the previous step

agents.name: linkedin-writer
agents.prompt: Write a LinkedIn post using the content analysis from the previous step

agents.name: post-scheduler
agents.prompt: Assemble all platform posts into a final schedule with optimal timing recommendations
